AgentRef skill 1.0.1

- Added OpenClaw integration metadata, including homepage URL and required environment variable (AGENTREF_API_KEY).
- Introduced guidance to prefer dedicated, minimally-scoped API keys for safer operation.
- Clarified recommendations around credential usage, including details for inspection-only and affiliate-only flows.
- No changes to functionality or endpoints; documentation improvements only.

Initial public release of the AgentRef OpenClaw skill.
Includes REST API authentication guidance, core AgentRef workflows, and curated endpoint references.
